description: This file defines the HeaderFooter class, which represents header or footer objects in a document, including methods to add and manipulate paragraphs, charts, tables, images, and text frames within headers/footers in a document generation context.

classes.name: HeaderFooter
classes.description: Represents a header or footer object in a document section, providing methods to add content types and properties to identify header/footer types.

classes.name: HeaderFooter.HeaderFooterValues
classes.description: Internal class encapsulating nullable properties for HeaderFooter, including style, format, elements, and comments.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the HeaderFooter object.

methods.name: AddParagraph
methods.description: Adds a new paragraph element to the header/footer.

methods.name: AddParagraph
methods.description: Adds a new paragraph with specified text to the header/footer.

methods.name: AddChart
methods.description: Adds a new chart with a specified type.

methods.name: AddChart
methods.description: Adds a new chart with default parameters.

methods.name: AddImage
methods.description: Adds a new image from a file.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an existing Paragraph, Chart, Table, Image, or TextFrame to the header/footer elements.
